latest_release.name: v8.2.0-BETA1
latest_release.body:
**Changelog** (https://github.com/symfony/console/compare/v8.1.11...v8.2.0-BETA1)

 * minor #67499  Warn about deprecated options passed by their negation or any of their shortcuts (@jack-worman)
 * minor #67319  Adapt Composer hints when using Symfony CLI (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67316  Add `command.invocation` and migrate command examples (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67328  Avoid temporary arrays when checking autocompletion keys (@andreybolonin)
 * feature #67258  Add `suggestPaths()` and `suggestDirectories()` to let the shell complete paths (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #67244 Improve the descriptions of the types and attributes registered for autoconfiguration (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #66985  Add an ASCII fast path to Helper::length() and Helper::substr() (@javiereguiluz)
 * minor #66976  Build the escape sequences of a color only once (@javiereguiluz)
 * minor #66968  Skip the stty probe when STDIN is not a terminal (@javiereguiluz)
 * minor #66961  Speed up writing to a section in several steps (@javiereguiluz)
 * feature #66950  Exit with 128 + the signal number when a signal stops the application (@lyrixx)
 * minor #66865  Add ttl param to `LockableTrait::lock()` (@HypeMC)
 * feature #66770  List the accepted values of enum arguments and options in the help (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #66775  Wrap exception messages on word boundaries (@nicolas-grekas)
 * feature #66622  Support lists of backed enums in # and # (@KalimeroMK)
 * feature #66020  Autowire the lock factory named "console" in LockableTrait (@nicolas-grekas)
 * feature #65853  Register class-level `#` groups and let the attribute list options (@nicolas-grekas)
 * feature #65825  Add docker-style sub-commands, resolved as command trees from registered names (@nicolas-grekas)
 * minor #65803  Declare docblock types for parameters of addArgument() and addOption() (@rgeraads)
 * feature #65616  Allow dropping multiple files (@chalasr)
 * feature #65368  Support union and intersection types as controller and command arguments (@HypeMC)
 * bug #65359  Fix "regular expression is too large" when wrapping on wide terminals (@HypeMC)
 * feature #63784  Auto-wrap TextDescriptor output based on terminal width (@Bellangelo)
 * feature #65304  Revert "Add a `listedAt` option to list a command only from a given verbosity" (@MatTheCat)
 * feature #64117  Add a `gitlab` output format to the `lint:yaml` command (@revoltek-daniel)
 * feature #61677  Allow callables for the description and help of `#`, `#` and `#` (@MacDada)
 * feature #64723  Add a `listedAt` option to list a command only from a given verbosity (@jprivet-dev)
 * feature #54439  Add hidden and deprecated option modes (@flkasper)
 * feature #64709  Improve FileInputHelper paste detection read performance (@jorgsowa)

Console Component
=================

The Console component eases the creation of beautiful and testable command line
interfaces.

Sponsor
-------

This package is looking for a [backer][1].

Help Symfony by [sponsoring][3] its development!

Resources
---------

 * [Documentation](https://symfony.com/doc/current/components/console.html)
 * [Contributing](https://symfony.com/doc/current/contributing/index.html)
 * [Report issues](https://github.com/symfony/symfony/issues) and
   [send Pull Requests](https://github.com/symfony/symfony/pulls)
   in the [main Symfony repository](https://github.com/symfony/symfony)

Credits
-------

`Resources/bin/hiddeninput.exe` is a third party binary provided within this
component. Find sources and license at https://github.com/Seldaek/hidden-input.
